description: UI components and pages layer — all visual work. Depends on FEAT-001 (services, types, geocoding must exist first). Fixes Button and Navbar, creates SkillPicker and AvailabilityToggle, replaces LocationInput with Nominatim, and fully implements Register, Login, Dashboard, and EditProfile pages.
steps: 1. Fix src/components/common/Button.tsx — add import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'. Change the href branch from <a href={href}> to <Link to={href} className={classes}>{content}</Link>. Keep the href prop name unchanged for backward compat. This fixes internal navigation for Navbar and all page links.

2. Replace src/components/common/LocationInput.tsx — full replacement with Nominatim. Props: { value: string; onLocationSelect: (loc: { locationName: string; lat: number; lng: number }) => void; error?: string; label?: string; required?: boolean }. Internal state: inputText (string), suggestions (Array<{display_name: string; lat: string; lon: string}>), isOpen (boolean), debounceRef (useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>). On input change: update inputText, clear debounceRef, set 500ms timeout -> call geocodeLocation from @/utils/geocoding -> set suggestions, isOpen=true. On suggestion click: call onLocationSelect({ locationName: item.display_name, lat: parseFloat(item.lat), lng: parseFloat(item.lon) }), set inputText to item.display_name, close dropdown. MapPin icon size=16 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400. Input: pl-9 for icon clearance, same classes as Input component. Dropdown: absolute z-10 w-full mt-1 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-md border border-slate-100. Each suggestion: px-4 py-2.5 font-sans text-sm text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 cursor-pointer. Close dropdown on outside click (useEffect with mousedown listener). Error display: same pattern as Input component (AlertCircle 14px + message). No Google Maps imports anywhere in this file.

3. Fix src/components/layout/Navbar.tsx — three changes: (a) Replace 'import { signOut } from firebase/auth' with 'import { signOut } from @/services/auth'. Remove the auth import from @/services/firebase if it was used only for the old signOut call (check — auth is imported from @/services/firebase and passed to firebase signOut; with the new import the auth param is no longer needed, just call signOut() directly). (b) Import Avatar from @/components/common/Avatar. (c) In the avatar button's inner content, replace the inline initials div and img with <Avatar name={user?.displayName ?? 'Provider'} size='sm' />. Keep all other Navbar classes, structure, mobile menu, and Link usage unchanged.

4. Create src/components/provider/SkillPicker.tsx — import Category from @/types/category. Props interface: { value: string[]; onChange: (skills: string[]) => void; categories: Category[]; error?: string }. Render: <div className='flex flex-wrap gap-2'>. For each category: <button type='button' onClick={toggle} className={selected ? 'bg-green-600 text-white ...' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-200 ...'}> {cat.label} </button>. Classes for chips: rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 font-sans text-sm font-medium transition-colors duration-150 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-500 focus:ring-offset-1. Toggle logic: if selected remove from array; if not selected and value.length < 10 add to array. Error: AlertCircle (14px) + message in text-red-600 text-sm mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-1.5.

5. Create src/components/provider/AvailabilityToggle.tsx — Props: { available: boolean; onChange: (value: boolean) => void; loading?: boolean }. Render a <button type='button' role='switch' aria-checked={available} onClick={() => onChange(!available)} onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' ') { e.preventDefault(); onChange(!available); } }} disabled={loading} className='flex items-center gap-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-500 focus:ring-offset-2 rounded-lg p-1'>. Inside: track div (w-11 h-6 rounded-full transition-colors duration-150, bg-green-600 if available else bg-slate-300) with thumb div inside (w-5 h-5 bg-white rounded-full shadow-sm transition-transform duration-150, translate-x-5 if available else translate-x-0.5). Then a <span> with status icon + label text. available=true: CheckCircle2 size=16 text-green-600 + 'Available for work' font-sans text-sm font-medium text-slate-700. available=false: XCircle size=16 text-slate-400 + 'Not available' font-sans text-sm text-slate-500. loading=true: replace status icon with Loader2 size=16 animate-spin text-slate-400. Use flex items-center gap-2 for the icon+label span.

6. Replace src/pages/RegisterPage.tsx — Two-step form. Step state: const [step, setStep] = useState<1|2>(1); const [uid, setUid] = useState(''); Step 1 Zod schema: z.object({ email: z.string().email(), password: z.string().min(8), confirmPassword: z.string() }).refine(d=>d.password===d.confirmPassword,{message:'Passwords do not match',path:['confirmPassword']}). Step 1 form: useForm with zodResolver. Heading 'Create your provider account' font-display text-2xl text-slate-900. Subtext font-sans text-sm text-slate-600. Email Input. Password Input with Eye/EyeOff Lucide icon toggle (useState showPassword). ConfirmPassword Input with same toggle. [Continue] primary Button loading={isSubmitting}. Divider: relative flex items-center with hr border-slate-200 and absolute-centered span 'or' font-sans text-xs text-slate-500 bg-white px-2. [Continue with Google] secondary Button. Link to /login 'Already have an account? Sign in' font-sans text-sm text-green-600. Form-level error state (string|null): show as bg-red-50 text-red-700 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 font-sans text-sm flex items-center gap-2 with AlertCircle size=16. On [Continue] submit: try registerWithEmail(data.email, data.password) from @/services/auth; on success setUid(cred.user.uid) setStep(2); on error map FirebaseError.code to message. On Google button click: similar with signInWithGoogle(). Step 2 Zod schema: z.object({ displayName: z.string().min(2), skills: z.array(z.string()).min(1,'Select at least one skill'), locationName: z.string().min(1), lat: z.number(), lng: z.number(), whatsappNumber: z.string().regex(/^\+[1-9]\d{7,14}$/,'Enter a valid number like +256 700 000 000'), bio: z.string().min(10).max(500) }). Step indicator: 'Step 2 of 2' text-right font-sans text-sm text-slate-500 mb-2. Heading 'Tell us about yourself' font-display text-2xl. Fields: displayName Input (required), SkillPicker (pass categories from useCategories(), register value via Controller), LocationInput (use Controller, onLocationSelect updates fields locationName/lat/lng), whatsappNumber Input (placeholder '+256 700 000 000', required), bio Textarea (maxLength=500, required). [Complete Registration] primary Button loading={isSubmitting}. On submit: call createProvider(uid, { displayName, email: currentUser?.email??'', whatsappNumber, bio, skills, location: new GeoPoint(lat||0.3476, lng||32.5825), locationName, available: true, isActive: true }) from @/services/firestore; import GeoPoint from firebase/firestore; on success call useToast for 'Welcome to Djema! Your profile is live.' then navigate('/dashboard'). Layout: max-w-md mx-auto py-12 px-4 flex flex-col gap-6.

7. Replace src/pages/LoginPage.tsx — Zod schema: z.object({ email: z.string().email(), password: z.string().min(1,'Password is required') }). Layout: max-w-sm mx-auto py-12 px-4 flex flex-col gap-6. Heading 'Welcome back' font-display text-2xl text-slate-900. Subtext 'Sign in to browse requests and find work.' font-sans text-sm text-slate-600. Email Input. Password Input with Eye/EyeOff toggle. [Sign In] primary Button loading={isSubmitting}. Divider + [Sign in with Google] secondary Button. Link to /register 'New to Djema? Register as a provider' font-sans text-sm text-green-600. Form-level error: same bg-red-50 banner pattern with AlertCircle. On submit: signInWithEmail(data.email, data.password) from @/services/auth; on success navigate('/dashboard'); on error map auth/invalid-credential, auth/wrong-password, auth/user-not-found -> 'Incorrect email or password.', auth/network-request-failed -> 'Network error. Check your connection.', default -> error.message. Google button: signInWithGoogle() then navigate('/dashboard') on success.

8. Replace src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx — import useAuth from @/hooks/useAuth; import getProvider, updateProvider from @/services/firestore; import Provider from @/types/provider; import Avatar from @/components/common/Avatar; import AvailabilityToggle from @/components/provider/AvailabilityToggle; import useNavigate, Link from react-router-dom; import signOut from @/services/auth; import Pencil, LogOut from lucide-react; import useToast from wherever it is defined. State: provider (Provider|null), loadingProvider (boolean), toggling (boolean). useEffect on mount: setLoadingProvider(true), getProvider(user!.uid) -> setProvider(data) setLoadingProvider(false), catch -> show error toast. Availability handler: async handleAvailabilityChange(val: boolean) { setToggling(true); setProvider(prev => prev ? {...prev, available:val} : prev); try { await updateProvider(user!.uid, {available:val}); } catch { setProvider(prev => prev ? {...prev, available:!val} : prev); } finally { setToggling(false); } }. Loading skeleton: if loadingProvider show 3 animate-pulse bg-slate-200 rounded-lg blocks (h-8, h-6, h-12 for example). UI when loaded: Row with Avatar size='lg' + h1 'Welcome back, {provider.displayName}' font-display text-2xl text-slate-900. Below: AvailabilityToggle available={provider.available} onChange={handleAvailabilityChange} loading={toggling}. hr border-slate-100 my-6. Heading 'Open requests matching your skills' font-display text-xl + p 'Browse the board to find work near you.' font-sans text-sm text-slate-600 mt-2. Button primary href='/board' 'Browse Open Requests'. hr border-slate-100 my-6. Flex row gap-3: Button ghost leftIcon=<Pencil size=16> href='/profile/edit' 'Edit Profile'. Button ghost leftIcon=<LogOut size=16> onClick={async()=>{await signOut();navigate('/')}} 'Sign Out'. Wrap in PageWrapper. Handle user=null guard: if !user redirect to /login.

9. Replace src/pages/EditProfilePage.tsx — Same Zod schema as Register step 2. On mount: getProvider(user!.uid) -> reset(formValues) mapping Provider fields to form shape. Fields: displayName Input, SkillPicker (Controller), LocationInput (Controller), whatsappNumber Input, bio Textarea maxLength=500. [Save Changes] primary Button loading={isSubmitting}. On submit: updateProvider(uid, { displayName, skills, location: new GeoPoint(lat||0.3476, lng||32.5825), locationName, whatsappNumber, bio }) from @/services/firestore; on success toast 'Profile updated.' stay on page; on error show error banner. Heading 'Edit your profile' font-display text-2xl. Layout: max-w-md mx-auto py-12 px-4 flex flex-col gap-6. Wrap in PageWrapper.

10. Verify and commit: run npx tsc --noEmit (fix all errors), run npx vite build (fix all errors), then git add all changed files and commit with message 'feat(phase-2): provider auth, registration, login, dashboard, availability toggle', then git push origin main.
acceptance_criteria: npx tsc --noEmit exits 0 with no TypeScript errors
npx vite build exits 0 with no build errors
Button component renders internal routes with react-router-dom Link (not plain <a>)
Navbar imports signOut from @/services/auth (not firebase/auth directly), uses Avatar component
LocationInput uses Nominatim geocoding — no Google Maps imports in the file
SkillPicker renders chips for all categories; toggles selection; caps at 10; shows error
AvailabilityToggle renders correct track/thumb colors for available=true and false; keyboard operable; loading state shows Loader2
RegisterPage step 1 creates Firebase Auth account; step 2 writes to Firestore providers/{uid}; navigates to /dashboard on success
LoginPage signs in and navigates to /dashboard; shows error banner on wrong credentials
DashboardPage loads provider data; availability toggle updates Firestore with optimistic UI
EditProfilePage pre-fills form with provider data; save writes updateProvider to Firestore
git commit with message 'feat(phase-2): provider auth, registration, login, dashboard, availability toggle' exists and pushed to origin main
findings: All steps implemented and verified. Button.tsx: replaced <a href> with <Link to>. LocationInput.tsx: full replacement using Nominatim geocoding via @/utils/geocoding — no Google Maps. Navbar.tsx: signOut now imported from @/services/auth (no more firebase/auth direct import), Avatar component used for profile display. SkillPicker.tsx: created with chip toggle, 10-skill cap, error display. AvailabilityToggle.tsx: created with accessible switch role, track/thumb animation, keyboard support, loading state. RegisterPage.tsx: two-step form with RHF+Zod, step 1 creates Firebase Auth account, step 2 writes Firestore via createProvider. LoginPage.tsx: full login with email/password and Google, error banner on failure. DashboardPage.tsx: loads provider, availability toggle with optimistic update, skeleton loading state. EditProfilePage.tsx: pre-fills from Firestore, updateProvider on save. npx tsc --noEmit exit 0. npx vite build exit 0 (chunk size warning only, not an error).
